newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Wichita, Kan.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF NOTE SALE
$47,555,000 AGGREGATE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT
CITY OF WICHITA, KANSAS
GENERAL OBLIGATION TEMPORARY NOTES
SERIES 192 AND SERIES 193
SUBJECT to the terms and conditions of the complete
Official Notice of Sale, dated July 1, 1997, of the City of
Wichita, Kansas (the "City"), in connection with the City's
hereinafter described Series of General Obligation.
Temporary Notes (the "Notes"), sealed, written bids for the
purchase of each of the Series of Notes shall be received at
the Office of the Mayor, First Floor, City Hall, 455 North
Main, Wichita, Kansas, until 10:30 o'clock A.M., Central
Time, on
Tuesday, July 22, 1997.
All bids shall be publicly opened and read aloud on said
date and at said time and place. The bids will be considered
and the Notes will be awarded by the City Council in the
City Council Chambers, City Hall, at 11:30 o'clock A.M.,
Central Time, on July 22, 1997.
No oral or auction bid shall be considered, and no bid for
less than the entire principal amount of a Series of Notes
shall be considered. Only bids proposing a single interest
rate for a Series of Notes will be considered. Bids will be
accepted only on the Official Bid Forms which have been
prepared for these Series of Notes, and which may be
obtained from the City's Department of Finance.
DESCRIPTION OF THE NOTES: The Series 192 Notes The General
Obligation Renewal and Improvement Temporary Notes, Series
192, shall be issued in the principal amount of $31,855,000,
shall be dated August 28, 1997, and shall mature February
26, 1998, with interest, at the rate specified by the
successful bidder, payable on maturity. The Series 192 Notes
shall be issued in book-entry-only form in denominations of
$5,000, or integral multiples thereof.
The Series 193 Notes The Taxable General Obligation
Renewal Temporary Notes, Series 193, shall be issued in the
principal amount of $15,700,000, shall be dated August 28,
1997, and shall mature February 26, 1998, with interest, at
the rate specified by the successful bidder, payable in
maturity. The Series 193 Notes shall be issued in book-
entry-only form in denominations of $5,000, or integral
multiples thereof.
REDEMPTION OF THE NOTES: The Notes are not subject to
redemption prior to maturity.
PAYING AGENT & REGISTRAR; PAYMENT OF PRINCIPAL AND
INTEREST: The principal amount of and the interest on the
Notes shall be paid by the City by wire transfer of same day
Funds to Cede & Co., nominee for The Depository Trust
Company, New York, New York ("DTC"). The transfer of
principal and interest payments to the participants of DTC
will be the responsibility of DTC, and the transfer of
principal and interest payments to beneficial owners by
participants of DTC will be the responsibility of
participants and other nominees of beneficial owners.
DELIVERY: On or about August 28, 1997. As a condition to
delivery, the successful bidders shall be required to
deposit the Notes with DTC.
LEGAL OPINION: Hinkle, Eberhart & Elkouri, L.L.C.,
Wichita, Kansas, whose fees will be paid by the City.
(Reference is made to the Official Notice of Note Sale and
the City's Preliminary Official Statement.)
SECURITY: The Notes and the interest thereon constitute
general obligations of the City, and the full faith, credit
and resources of the City are pledged to the payment
thereof. (Reference is made to the Official Notice of Note
Sale and the City's Preliminary Official Statement.)
RATINGS: The City has applied to Moody's Investors
Service, Inc. and Standard & Poor's Corporation for ratings
on these Notes. The City's most recently issued Temporary
Notes (sold January 28, 1997) were rated MIG 1 by Moody's
Investors Service, Inc. and SP-1+ by Standard & Poor's
Corporation.
OFFICIAL STATEMENT: The City has authorized and directed
preparation of a Preliminary Official Statement in
connection with the Notes. Said Preliminary Official
Statement is in a form "deemed final" by the City for the
purpose of the Securities Exchange Commission's Rule l5c2-
12(b)(1), but is subject to revision, amendment and
completion in the final Official Statement. Not later than
seven business days after the date of the sale of the Notes,
the City shall furnish the respective successful bidders
with a reasonable number of copies of the final Of Official
Statement, without cost.
CONTINUING DISCLOSURE: The City has adopted an Ordinance
establishing a master undertaking to provide ongoing
disclosure concerning the City in connection with its
general obligation notes for the benefit of owners of the
Notes, as required under Section (b)(5)(i) of Securities and
Exchange Commission Rule 1 5c2- 12. The Ordinance is the
Official Statement.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Copies of the complete Official
Notice of Sale and Official Bid Form and of the Preliminary
Official Statement may be obtained from the Department of
Finance, City Hall, Twelfth Floor, 455 North Main, Wichita,
Kansas 67202-1679, Telephone 316-268-4584 (Ms. Kelly
Carpenter, Assistant Director of Finance).
CITY OF WICHITA, KANSAS
By PAT BURNETT, City Clerk
(From The Bond Buyer)
